page.layout: One page of text, single column, with a running title heading above it; the left edge of the column is cut away by the scan so the lines begin mid-word. No margin notes, no page number, no catchword.
page.notes: The left part of each line is cut off by the scan edge; the visible text is transcribed only. The final word "le" at the foot of the column is printed alone at the right, and is the start of the next line's word, so it is kept as the last line. Several words are blurred by show-through and may be misread, notably "reçeüe", "vienne" and "tim-ens" in the middle of the page.
